name: Stop Motion: Location Establishing Clip
description: Video preset for a location clip in the Stop Motion look.
system_prompt: Write one video prompt for a 5 second establishing shot. State the camera move, time of day, and two things moving in the scene. Keep the architecture consistent with the entity.
context_prompt: short establishing clip of the location with one slow camera move and ambient life in the frame, stop-motion puppet animation still, handmade clay and felt puppets with visible fingerprints and stitching, miniature set built from real materials, small practical lamps, shallow depth of field of a macro lens, warm tabletop lighting, animated on twos with slight frame-to-frame jitter, tactile material boil, small deliberate camera moves on a miniature rig
negative_prompt: smooth cgi, photorealistic human, flat 2d, digital gloss, motion blur, text, watermark, flicker, morphing, warped faces
